content.introduction: On October 26, 2026, former GitHub CEO launched a rival platform built for AI coding agents. Also on October 26, Microsoft made a new ‘voluntary exit’ offer to about a quarter of its workforce, including some executives. On October 28, former T-Mobile CEO Mike Sievert exited the board of directors of the wireless giant. On October 20, autonomous flight startup Reliable Robotics opened a radar hub in the Seattle area with a valuation topping $1 billion. On the same day, Amazon planned record 300k holiday hires as the rest of retail pulled back. On October 22, startup Spotlight featured an apparel marketplace for indie artists founded by an ex-Amazon duo.
